The tools on the tool strip.

| Label | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.select}} | Select objects on the drawing. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.move}} | Move tool: drop the selection at the cursor. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.wire}} | Wire tool: click two pins to connect them. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.no_connect}} | Mark a pin deliberately unconnected. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.route}} | Route tool: click two pads to start a track. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.line}} | Draw a straight line on a user layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.box}} | Draw a box on a user layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.circle}} | Draw a circle on a user layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.outline}} | Draw an outline on a user layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.text}} | Print words on a user layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.draw_shape}} | Draw cut lines, perforations or printed marks on your own layer. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.cutout}} |  |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.mounting_hole}} | Drill an unplated hole for a screw or spacer; then click the board where it goes. |
| {{ui:board.tool_strip.assembly_mark}} | A bare copper disc the pick-and-place camera finds the board by; then click a clear corner. |
